dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250903-SDN-01](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250903-SDN-01) A flood occurred on Sep 03 2025 in Sudan. It affected an estimated 257054 people and 84514 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
